grounding.excerpt: The permittee is required to submit a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water

payload.rationale: The operative permit clause for Delta-BHC requires submission of a detailed plan to test at the source water intake. That procedural plan-and-test compliance obligation establishes a special-study / compliance-schedule character rather than a routine FY2025 DMR numeric discharge limit; the packet span states no effluent numeric limit, monitoring frequency, or DMR reporting requirement for Delta-BHC. Permit term (2022-01-01 through 2026-12-31) and the FY2025 window situate timing but do not alter the obligation type grounded in part_i.
